name: Stain
author: Erin Carter
description: A stained-glass window of large irregular panes, each holding a palette colour pulled down to barely above black behind bright leading. Nothing crosses the glass — panes take turns blooming from within on long overlapping cycles, leaning toward a neighbouring hue at the peak.

params.label: Pane size
params.effect: Average pane diameter in CSS pixels; smaller panes feel like dense chapel glass, larger panes like a grand rose-window detail.

params.label: Bloom rate
params.effect: Pace of the panes' bloom cycles, from devotional near-stillness to a window restless with colour.

params.label: Lit fraction
params.effect: Roughly what fraction of panes are lit at any moment — a lone bloom or two, or half the window awake at once.

params.label: Lead thickness
params.effect: Thickness of the bright leading lines between panes; heavy lead makes the partition graphic, fine lead lets colour dominate.
